text:
Arman: proposing we build a small cross-partner harness to produce reproducible perf/W and throughput numbers for partner boards (EdgeNova). want a minimal spec teams can run in their labs and partners can run in theirs.
Priya: sounds good. what do you want in the canonical output? csv/json fields?
Arman: CSV first (easier offline), fields: run_id, model, model_variant, seq_len, batch, tokens_total, throughput_tps, p50_ms, p95_ms, p99_ms, avg_power_w, joules_per_token, temp_c, notes. also include raw power timeseries for audit.
Linh: +1. also include how power is measured (onboard sensors vs PDU). need a calibration step.
Zoe: lab scheduling note: EdgeNova asked for a 4‑hour window for initial sweep. also need the partner NDA signed before sharing raw telemetry.
Rick: kernel changes: any perf patches must come with a repeatable build artifact and a `git tag` of the kernel + patch. we cannot accept untracked local kernels for official numbers.
Priya: measurement details: sample power at 200ms or faster, report sample rate, and run at least 3 independent runs with different seeds. define a warmup of 200 steps. define steady-state window for power average.
Linh: example run command for harness (sketch):
```
python run_bench.py \
  --model gpt-small \
  --seq 1024 \
  --batch 1 \
  --steps 1500 \
  --power-sample 0.2 \
  --power-source pdu \
  --output out.csv
```
Zoe: ci note: we should have CI-bot trigger nightly reproducibility runs on a cheap reference board and then partners run a full sweep. ci-bot, can you create a nightly job?
ci-bot: created job `partner-harness-nightly` and ticket RED-893.
Arman: integration points: 1) harness repo (public private partner repo), 2) measurement spec doc, 3) lab booking calendar entry, 4) telemetry S3 share with restricted ACLs.
Priya: for thermal effects, capture device temp + external ambient every sample. also record fan curve state.
Rick: for kernel microbench, include short microbench for matmul/fused-attn with perf counters: cycles, l3_miss, instructions. small binary with reproducible config.
Zoe: I'll coordinate NDAs and put the partner contact (EdgeNova eng: sara@edgenova) on the doc. lab booking tentative Wed 10–2 next week.
Arman: timeline: draft RFC + repo skeleton by Fri, measurement spec v0.1 by Mon, initial EdgeNova run next Wed. assign owners: @Priya spec, @Linh harness, @Zoe partner ops, @Rick kernel guardrails.
Priya: ack, will drop a spec PR and include example parsers for CSV -> parquet.
Linh: ack, will spin up harness repo and add the run template + small Docker image.
Zoe: ack, will chase NDA and confirm Wed slot.
Rick: will write kernel patch checklist and tagging policy.
devops-bot: lab booking confirmed for Wed 10:00–14:00 (room: perf-lab-3).
Arman: thanks all — I'll post the RFC link here when ready. :thumbsup:
